text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PIN applied: runtime v3.8 pinned for model-group code-llama in us-west-1 due to increased bind errors and tokenization mismatches after SDK 2.6.0 canary. Pin window: 6h. https://ops/inc/1755558888 

claire: saw customer reports + our CI diffs. mismatch rate ~0.6% starting ~22:10 PST. any quick root cause?

sam: correlated with sdk 2.6.0 change to token normalization. runtime v3.8 enforces stricter token sequence validation, causing bind failures for some legacy prompts.

ops-bot: Quick mitigation options:

```
/deploy pin runtime v3.8 --model code-llama --region us-west-1 --until 2024-07-12T04:00Z
/deploy route add --from runtime:v3.8 --to runtime:v3.6 --region us-west-1 --match "header:x-token-mode=legacy"
/deploy canary pause sdk 2.6.0
```

claire: applied header-route for x-token-mode=legacy. smoke shows bind errors for that traffic dropped to 0 in 7m.

sam: i'll open a minimal SDK patch to add a backward-compat toggle and rollback the canary. PR: https://git/repo/pull/9876. plan: revert canary, land toggle, then staged unpin.

ops-bot: Suggested soft-unpin plan: low-traffic window 02:00 UTC next day. ramps: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m gates. rollback triggers: bind-errors >0 OR token-mismatch-rate >0.1% OR p95 > baseline+30%. auto-rollback will route affected traffic to v3.6 and page #eng-oncall.

claire: drafting release note: "Temporary pin of runtime v3.8 in us-west-1 for code-llama due to tokenization/bind mismatches following SDK 2.6.0; legacy-token traffic routed to v3.6 while SDK toggle is implemented. Customers may see transient differences for some prompt variants." will post after approvals.

sam: follow-ups: (1) ship SDK patch + toggle, (2) run longseq/token-diff regression suite, (3) confirm gate metrics during each ramp. I'll own 1 & 2.

ops-bot: Pin remains in effect. To request immediate unpin use `/deploy unpin runtime v3.8 --region us-west-1` and tag eng-releases for approval.

claire: thanks — keep updates here. close when soft-unpin completes and postmortem is published. :lock:
